details: Stock id5100.py decodes tone mode 8 as 'DTCS-T' (DTCS encode only) and 2/4 as '2??'/'4??' (pocket beep), none valid CHIRP tone modes, so one such channel aborts the whole channel decode. Override maps DTCS-T to Cross 'DTCS->', pocket-beep TSQL/DTCS to TSQL/DTCS (kept on unchanged write-back), undefined values to no tone, and offers TSQL-R/DTCS-R. Covers ID-4100 too. No image attached.
